<section_guide number="8" title="MVP Metrics" references="2,5">
<purpose>Define data collection/analysis methods and success thresholds</purpose>

<required_review>
MUST review referenced sections before writing:

- Section 2 (MVP Goals): Call alps_section(action: 'read', doc_path, section: 2) for KPIs to measure
- Section 5.2 (Non-Functional Requirements): Call alps_section(action: 'read', doc_path, section: 5) for NFRs to validate
  </required_review>

<nfr_threshold_mapping>
Every measurable NFR threshold from Section 5.2 MUST map 1:1 to a Success Threshold row here in 8.2 (or to a named release test). Carry the SAME number across — if 5.2 says "API responses under 3 seconds (p95)", 8.2 must hold a row with target "< 3 seconds (p95)" and 8.1 must list how it is collected (e.g., APM monitoring). Walk the NFR list and confirm each one is validated here; if an NFR can only be checked by a release test rather than an ongoing metric, say so explicitly instead of dropping it.
Match the value, unit, population, and measurement condition together. Daily active users are not concurrent users. If one NFR contains several thresholds, give each threshold its own check without inventing a new requirement.
</nfr_threshold_mapping>

<tension_metrics>
Carry every tension metric from Section 2 together with the KPI it protects, so a later agent compares both before calling a KPI gain an improvement. Give it a collection method in 8.1. In 8.2, a monitoring-only tension needs no target; record a target only when the user confirmed it as a required success condition. If a KPI here has no proposed tension yet, propose one from its abuse or opposite-failure scenario; the user decides adoption.
</tension_metrics>

<questions>
1. How will you measure each goal from Section 2?
2. What are the data collection methods for each KPI and each NFR from Section 5.2?
3. What is the success threshold (target value) for each KPI and NFR?
</questions>

<example>
These rows continue the illustrative KPIs from Section 2 and NFRs from Section 5. They are not product defaults.

### 8.1 Data Collection Methods

| Metric                              | Collection Method                                            | Related Feature/KPI                                       |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| Average document writing time       | Session start to approved document completion                | Section 2 writing-time KPI                                |
| Conversation context retention rate | Compare supplied context with the resulting document         | Section 2 context-retention KPI; tension for writing time |
| Concurrent document authors         | Peak-workload release test                                   | NF1                                                       |
| Document generation time            | Generation request-to-result timing during the peak workload | NF1                                                       |
| Auth enforced before save           | Release test                                                 | NF2                                                       |

### 8.2 Success Thresholds

| KPI / NFR                                 | Baseline | Target                 | Measurement Period              |
| ----------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| Average document writing time (KPI)       | N/A      | &lt; 30 minutes        | Per completed authoring session |
| Conversation context retention rate (KPI) | N/A      | ≥ 90%                  | Per reviewed authoring session  |
| Concurrent document authors (NF1)         | N/A      | 1,000 concurrent users | Peak-workload release test      |
| Document generation time (NF1)            | N/A      | ≤ 30 seconds           | During the same peak workload   |
| Auth required before save (NF2)           | N/A      | 100% enforced          | Release test                    |

  </example>

Mark converted content with `Source requirements:` and the Lite IDs it covers.

Read Lite Section 6.1 and Section 4.1. For every `KPI-n` and `TM-n`, keep the Lite business calculation, window and required or monitoring use, and add only the data collection method and instrumentation.
